audit.whatIsWrong: Riftwalk is named as the matchup-defining cooldown everywhere but no number is ever given, and dosFull[2].d invents one: "take the fifteen-second invitation". Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s.
audit.why: A player told to wait fifteen seconds after a Riftwalk will walk into the next one. The real spike shape is the opposite: it is barely ever down, which is exactly why the lane must be won before level 6.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry 500 range and 5/3.5/2s; phases[4], whys[4], spikes[2] and wants.foe[1] carry the 5s rank-1 figure. Mirror kassadin__lillia added the same numbers from its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) The page asserts a Kassadin Q silence five times — whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[1], content.mid, content.late — and has it shutting off Lilting Lullaby. Riot's Null Sphere text is "deals damage and interrupts channels"; there is no silence, and Lilting Lullaby is not a channel, so the interaction does not exist. (b) The decisive real interaction is missing: Void Stone reduces magic damage and Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage, but Blooming Blows' outer ring deals TRUE damage, which goes through both. The page instead says his shield "softens my poke".
audit.why: A fabricated silence tells the player to hold his ult for a mechanic that isn't in the game, while the one thing that genuinely beats Kassadin's magic-damage-reduction profile — the true-damage Q edge — is never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Silence removed from all five strings and replaced with the Riftwalk blink numbers; tldr and report[0].t now state that his shield and passive eat magic damage while the Q outer ring is true damage.
sources: enemyKit P text "takes reduced magic damage"
enemyKit Q flag shield "absorbs magic damage"

edits.before: This is where Kassadin reclaims everything — he's a hard scaler and a stacked Riftwalk plus his first AP completion lets him blink through my short hops, silence my sleep, and delete my squishy body before the burn matters. I don't try to solo-duel a fully-online Kassadin; that's a losing trade once he's got items. My whole plan is to cash my level-4-to-first-item lead into roams, plates, and map pressure so the game is decided before his true scaling arrives, then play for picks where my R can isolate-sleep someone other than him.
